title: Amaysim: Unlimited 240GB 12-Month Plan $199 (was $320), Plus $85 Cashback at TopCashback AU
body:

I'm looking at this Sim for myself
[abhezus] TCB support. Cashback has not reflected in my account still. I have raised a ticket but they seem to have submitted to retailer. It’s a long and tardy process and I’m not even sure if I’ll get cashback despite sticking to all conditions around eligibility and activation.
[cook99] Yikes there is negs on the Vodafone equivalent deal for no tracking… Where is tightarse?
[tightarse] Hi, I'm here. 😊
Please note that there is nothing wrong with the tracking. I sometimes wish everyone whose purchase tracked successfully would comment too, as I can assure you the ratio would probably be around 1 in every 200 or so that fails to track for various reasons.
Generally only those whose purchases don't track will comment, which can sometimes give the impression that there's a wider issue when there isn't.
If there ever is or has been a broader tracking issue affecting any of our deals, I've always been transparent about it and have let everyone know.
Cheers!
[Sterego] I reached out to you on a similar deal after it didn’t track. You replied saying to raise a ticket - which I did. TCB came back to me three months later, closed the ticket while also asking me for an order number which was provided in the ticket. There was no way to re open the ticket, apart from lodging a new ticket.
Last time I will use TCB.
[tightarse] @Sterego: I have no record of you reaching out to me. And I can assure you that had you done so, I would have responded on the same day as I always do for others. It would have to be something out of the ordinary for me to take longer than a day or two. I'm always here to help as best I can. Cheers.
Edit: I can see you edited your comment to remove the part about me not responding for 1 month.

[jaboday423] My plan ends last week of November, when does this sim needs to activated (if get this deal on 31st Oct 2026 and activate by last week of Nov 2026)?
[jaboday423] SIM must be activated within 20 days of purchase to be eligible for cashback. Failure to do so will result in cashback being declined. Cashback is ineligible on recharges to existing services, phones, Amaysim refer-a-friend (RAF) sales, SIMs bought from retail stores or outlets. Cashback is eligible for new & existing Amaysim customers on purchase of a new service (SIM). Cashback is eligible only on the (SIM) UNLIMITED 240GB/365 day plan only, and not eligible if purchased with any phone.
Cashback is ineligible on recharges to existing services, phones, phone deals, amaysim refer-a-friend (RAF) sales, SIMs bought from retail stores or outlets.
Cashback is ineligible on use of any coupon codes not advertised on our platform.
Cashback is ineligible on use of gift cards, vouchers, or store credit for partial or full payment. Cashback is also ineligible on purchase of gift cards.
Cashback is ineligible on purchases made via the retailer's mobile app.
